source.title: National Curriculum in England: English programmes of study
source.note: Aldar Academies' British schools follow the National Curriculum for England (primary/KS3) then IGCSE and A-Level via Pearson Edexcel and Cambridge. Commercial textbooks (Pearson, Cambridge, CGP, Oxford, Collins) are copyrighted and are NOT bundled here; the links below point to the official, free curriculum specifications and free revision resources. To add an actual textbook.pdf, drop a licensed copy into this folder.
